entries.scope: Bilingual secure-development practice guide and Level-0 navigation
entries.rationale: Learners and non-specialist developers need an evidence-linked explanation of scan findings and secure coding without expanding the root README.
audiences: Apprentices in the four IT occupations
readerPaths: README.md -> practice guide -> binding guideline and checklists -> historical evidence
docs/README.en.md -> English practice guide -> binding guideline and checklists
entries.navigationImpact: Short direct links in the root README and three existing documentation indexes.
entries.languageStrategy: Separate German and equivalent English partner files, CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Examples are mapped to the dated Level-0 Deep Scan, CodeQL remediation, and shared-alert reports; relative links and structural accessibility are checked. No new practical screen-reader or Braille test is claimed.
entries.risk: Historical findings could be mistaken for current repository status; the guide dates examples and requires revision-bound review.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Changed scan evidence, language/toolchain coverage, threat model, secure-development baseline, or reader navigation.
